Application Materials.content:
To apply for the MITB Programme, the following documents will be required to accompany each online application:
- Softcopy of your updated CV
- Softcopy of relevant certificates and academic transcripts
- Softcopy of Passport and/or NRIC
- Two references: please provide the name, email and contact number of two referees.
- Referees will be notified to complete their referral forms online.

Interview Requirements.content:
Generally, we take into consideration the candidate’s work experience, aptitude, GMAT/GRE scores, recommendation from referees, previous academic prowess and **admission interview performance** when doing our assessment.
Once you have completed your online application, an officer from our admissions team will get in touch with you within a month to advise you on the next steps, including the submission deadline for your GMAT/GRE exam scores. You will also be informed if you are **shortlisted for an admission interview with our programme director**.
Due to the increase in our application numbers, offers will be given to candidates who have **passed the interviews**, with the highest GMAT/GRE in our batch selection process.
Are there admission interviews? **Yes. We will contact you for an admission interview after receiving your online application.**

Academic Requirements.content:
- 申请人有**本科以上学历**，**无专业限制**。
- **有无工作经验都可以申请**。
- 以下申请人可以使用本科CGPA代替SMUAT/GRE/GMAT成绩：SMU校友，**CGPA 3.4/4.0或以上**，且在毕业5年内；NUS/NTU/SUTD/SUSS/SIT校友，**GPA 3.6/5.0或以上**，且在毕业5年内。
- 注意：满足上述CGPA学术标准并不能保证被录取。

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
**All** MITB applicants are eligible to take the **SMU Admission Test** in lieu of GMAT/GRE as entry criteria to the MITB programme. The SMU Admissions Test score cut off is Overall score of **56**.
Undergraduate CGPA may be used in place of GMAT/GRE/SMU Admission Test scores for the following applicants:
- SMU graduates with a minimum cGPA of **3.0/4.0** (within 5 years of graduation)
- SUTD/NUS/NTU/SUSS/SIT graduates with a minimum cGPA of **3.6/5.0** (within 5 years of graduation)
Each applicant is only allowed a maximum of **4 test attempts per intake** (including deferment). A test fee is payable for every test attempt. [Click here for SMU AT Candidate Guide](https://masters.smu.edu.sg/sites/masters.smu.edu.sg/files/uploads/SMUAT_Candidate_Guide_v2.pdf)
Make online payment for **$125 (inclusive of GST)** test fee at: [https://admissions.eservices.smu.edu.sg/Application/Login](https://admissions.eservices.smu.edu.sg/Application/Login). Do note that test fee payment is non-refundable. After payment has been processed, email your payment receipt to [mitb@smu.edu.sg](mailto:mitb@smu.edu.sg). A test account will then be emailed to you in about 3 working days.
**TEST RULE:** Please perform the test without any aid. During the test, you are not supposed to refer to any book or reference materials, be it physical form or online. Once the SMU admission test has started, you must complete all 3 test components at one go. [Click here for our Test Policy](https://masters.smu.edu.sg/programme/master-of-it-in-business/MITBTP)

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
- IELTS, UKVI (Academic) or TOEFL is required for applicants whose Degree programme (Bachelor's/Master's/PhD) was not taught in English. TOEFL Code: **9014**.
- Minimum Requirements [IELTS/UKVI (Academic)/TOEFL]: IELTS/UKVI (Academic) - **Min 6.5**, or TOEFL - **Min Score: 90, Band: 4.5**.
- The TOEFL/IELTS (SMU’s TOEFL Code: **9014**) is only required for applicants whose Degree programme was not taught in English.

Program Overview.content:
The Master of IT in Business (MITB) programme draws from thought leadership in data analytics, technological platforms and business strategies, and delves into five specialisation tracks: Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Science & Analytics, Digital Transformation and Financial Technology & Analytics. The Analytics (AT) track has been rebranded to Data Science & Analytics (DSA) track as of April 2025.
MITB has a 12 to 24 months duration with August and January intake. Modes of study are Full-time & Part-Time. The Master of IT in Business is an intensive programme with 2 options for completion: full-time candidature from a minimum of 1 year to a maximum of 3 years, and part-time candidature from a minimum of 2 years to a maximum of 5 years. Students can switch between these 2 modes of candidature at any time, but the change can only be made once.
MITB class sessions are 3 hours long, and are conducted in a highly interactive, seminar-styled manner. Class sessions combine lectures with discussions, hands-on lab sessions, problem-solving practice classes, and group work. Through the pedagogy, students have the opportunity to interact closely with faculty, full-time professional hires (instructors) and student teaching assistants. Students also meet with industry experts who share their experiences and perspectives through regular seminars organised by the MITB programme. All classes are held either on weekday evenings from 7pm onwards, Saturday mornings from 8.15am onwards, or Saturday afternoons from 12pm onwards, with some weekday morning or afternoon classes for full-time students in their first term.
Why pursue MITB:
- High graduate employability: graduates are sought after by corporations from industries such as Apple, Google, PayPal, Grab, etc. 9 out of 10 graduates are employed within six months upon graduation. Download the [employment report](https://scispg.smu.edu.sg/acton/fs/blocks/showLandingPage/a/44865/p/p-002a/t/page/fm/0) to read more.
- Constantly evolving and relevant curriculum: stay up to date on the current IT market trends and technologies.
- World-class faculty and industry practitioners: learn from faculty who are experts in their fields, with opportunities to learn from real-world scenarios.
- Internships and capstone projects: choose between an internship to gain real-world working experience, or a capstone project to research independently on a specific topic.
Class profile data from Class of 2025 (Full-time & Part-time): Typical Age Range 22 - 32; International Student 47%; Total Nationalities 18; Average Years of Work Experience 4.1. Academic background data collated from graduating students from 2023 and 2024: Business / Financial Services 36%; Engineering 33%; Computing 13%; Science 13%; Art & Social Sciences 5%.
The MITB Internship is an experiential learning experience for students to apply knowledge acquired in the MITB program within the professional setting. The internships are aligned with the aims of the MITB program and students’ respective tracks, providing career-related work experience, industry exposure, professional networks, guidance and professional support.
The MITB capstone project is an extensive, applied practice research project undertaken by students, supervised by SMU faculty members who have specific expertise and interest in the topic, and sometimes sponsored by external companies. It provides an individualized learning experience to integrate and synthesize the skills, theories, and frameworks learned in the MITB programme, and to apply them in a real-world setting.

Curriculum.content:
The Master of IT in Business (MITB) programme delves into five specialisation tracks: Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Science & Analytics, Digital Transformation and Financial Technology & Analytics. The Analytics (AT) track has been rebranded to Data Science & Analytics (DSA) track as of April 2025.
The MITB curriculum has its courses classified into the following series:
- Core Courses: Computational Thinking with Python; Spreadsheet Modelling for Decision Making; Statistical Thinking for Data Science.
- Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) content is woven into all MITB core courses.
- Practicum: Internship (2 CUs) or Capstone Project (2 CUs).
- Students may choose to cross-enrol up to two (02) pre-approved [SCIS PhD courses](https://masters.smu.edu.sg/programme/master_of_it_in_business/cross-enrolment-of-scis-phd-courses-for-mitb-students) and count towards MITB graduation requirements as track electives or open electives.
Modes of Study: Full-time & Part-Time. The Master of IT in Business is an intensive programme with 2 options for completion:
- Full-time candidature: a minimum of 1 year to a maximum of 3 years. Period of Candidature (Year): Minimum 1, Normal 1.5.
- Part-time candidature: a minimum of 2 years to a maximum of 5 years. Period of Candidature (Year): Minimum 2, Normal 2.5.
- Students can switch between these 2 modes of candidature at any time, but the change can only be made once. Students are allowed to apply for a conversion of their candidature (Full/Part-Time) only once in their entire duration of the programme.
Course Delivery and Timetable: MITB class sessions are 3 hours long, and are conducted in a highly interactive, seminar-styled manner. Class sessions combine lectures with discussions, hands-on lab sessions, problem-solving practice classes, and group work. All classes are held either on weekday evenings from 7pm onwards, Saturday mornings from 8.15am onwards, or Saturday afternoons from 12pm onwards. These timings have been chosen to accommodate the schedules of part-time students who are working, and full-time students who might be engaged with industry attachments. However, full-time students may have some weekday morning or afternoon classes (8.15am, 12pm or 3.30pm onwards) in their first term.
Artificial Intelligence Electives:
- Algorithm Design & Implementation; Applied Machine Learning*; Natural Language Processing for Smart Assistants*; Recommender Systems*; Agentic AI for Intelligent Autonomy; Human-AI Interaction Design; Artificial Intelligence and Uncertainty Reasoning*; Deep Learning for Visual Recognition#; Query Processing and Optimisation; Generative AI with LLMs*; Prompt Engineering for LLMs (0.5 CU); Machine Learning Engineering*; AI System Evaluation*; Introduction to Reinforcement Learning*; AI Adoption & Industry Analysis% (Without Credit); AI in Financial Markets Forecasting (0.5 CU).
- %The AI Adoption & Industry Analysis is a graduation requirement (without credit) for AI track students.
Graduation Requirements for Artificial Intelligence Track: Students must complete and pass a total of 15 Course Units (CUs) with a minimum cumulative Grade Point Average (GPA) of 2.5 to graduate with the MITB degree.
- Postgraduate professional development course: 1 CU.
- Programme core: 3 CUs: Spreadsheet Modeling for Decision Making; Statistical Thinking for Data Science; Computational Thinking with Python.
- Track Core: 4 CUs: Algorithm Design & Implementation; Artificial Intelligence and Uncertainty Reasoning*; Applied Machine Learning*; Query Processing & Optimisation.
- Track electives: 3 CUs: Choose any 3 Artificial Intelligence Electives.
- Open electives: 4 CUs: Choose any 4 CUs from Internship or Capstone Project (2 CUs), courses from any series in the MITB curriculum, or courses from other SMU Masters programmes (up to 2 CUs).
Cybersecurity Electives:
- Cybersecurity Technology & Applications; AI-Driven Security Analysis; Threat Intelligence & Incident Response; Enterprise Cryptography; Strategic Cybersecurity Management; AI System Evaluation*#; Cloud Security; Agile & DevSecOps.
Graduation Requirements for Cybersecurity Track: Students must complete and pass a total of 15 Course Units (CUs) with a minimum cumulative Grade Point Average (GPA) of 2.5 to graduate with the MITB degree.
- Postgraduate professional development course: 1 CU.
- Programme core: 3 CUs: Spreadsheet Modeling for Decision Making; Statistical Thinking for Data Science; Computational Thinking with Python.
- Track Core: 4 CUs: Cybersecurity Technology & Applications; Strategic Cybersecurity Management; Threat Intelligence & Incident Response; AI-Driven Security Analysis.
- Track electives: 3 CUs: Choose any 3 Cybersecurity Electives.
- Open electives: 4 CUs: Choose any 4 CUs from Internship or Capstone Project (2 CUs), courses from any series in the MITB curriculum, or courses from other SMU Masters programmes (up to 2 CUs).
Data Science & Analytics Electives:
- Data Management; Big Data: Tools & Techniques; Applied Data Science in Social Networks; Query Processing and Optimisation; Generative AI with LLMs*; Data Analytics Lab; Applied Data Science for Customer Insights (SMU-X); Visual Analytics & Applications; Geospatial Analytics & Applications; Applied Data Science in Healthcare (0.5 CU); Data Science for Business*; Applied Data Science in Operations; Text Analytics & Applications; Applied Machine Learning*; Prompt Engineering for LLMs (0.5 CU).
Graduation Requirements for Data Science & Analytics Track: Students must complete and pass a total of 15 Course Units (CUs) with a minimum cummulative Grade Point Average (GPA) of 2.5 to graduate with the MITB degree.
- Postgraduate professional development course: 1 CU.
- Programme core: 3 CUs: Spreadsheet Modeling for Decision Making; Statistical Thinking for Data Science; Computational Thinking with Python.
- Track Core: 4 CUs: Data Analytics Lab; Data Science for Business*; Applied Machine Learning*; Query Processing & Optimisation.
- Track electives: 3 CUs: Choose any 3 Data Science & Analytics Electives.
- Open Electives: 4 CUs: Choose any 4 CUs from Internship or Capstone Project (2 CUs), courses from any series in the MITB curriculum, or courses from other SMU Masters programmes (up to 2 CUs).
Postgraduate Professional Development Course:
- MITB Full-time Students: Compulsory to take 3 CDS workshops (0.25CU); select 3 remaining workshops from the other 3 buckets (0.75CU).
- MITB Part-time Students: CDS workshops are optional; select 4 workshops from any of the non-Career buckets to attain 1 CU.
The MITB Internship is an experiential learning experience for students to apply knowledge acquired in the MITB program within the professional setting. The internships are aligned with the aims of the MITB program and students’ respective tracks.
The MITB capstone project is an extensive, applied practice research project that is undertaken by students, supervised by SMU faculty members who have specific expertise and interest in the topic, and sometimes sponsored by external companies. Students shall identify a problem, develop the approach and methods needed to address the problem, and conduct the research and present the findings in both oral and written formats.
The Global Exposure Project (GEP) is a joint initiative between MITB and Sogang University, offered as a 1 CU practicum module, over a 5-week period during the July Term of the academic calendar.

- SMU MITB Women in Tech Scholarship: open to female students of any nationality enrolled in the MITB programme in Academic Year 2026/27; each scholarship is valued at **S$16,660** and offers partial financial support towards tuition fees. No bond is required. Valid for the August 2026 intake.

Each scholarship award is valued at **S$90,000** and offers financial support towards MITB tuition fees; any excess will be used for study related expenses. No bond is required; a separate application is required [here](https://forms.office.com/r/A37RFLq78H).

The scholarship offers partial financial support towards annual tuition fees, no bond is required, and MITB applicants who meet the criteria will automatically be considered.

Priority is given to candidates with strong aspirations for career advancement and career transition into one of the MITB specialization tracks.

Application opens at the end of every 10-week term, subject to scholarship seat vacancy.

No bond is required.

No bond is required; separate application is required [here](https://forms.office.com/r/qw9cvk42ia).

Multiple Applications.content: If you have applied for more than one programme, you are only required to take the test once. Please contact your first-choice’s programme office to register for the test and update the other programme office upon the completion of your test via email to ensure timely processing of all your SMU applications.

Deferral Admission Policy.content:
- Applicants must matriculate into the SMU PGP programme for which the scholarship has been awarded with. As the scholarship offered is only valid for this FY, matriculated students who defer their studies will not be able to carry forward their scholarships.
- Each applicant is only allowed a maximum of **4 test attempts per intake (including deferment)**. A test fee is payable for every test attempt.

Conditional Admission Policy.content: UIBE undergraduate students who have completed the 3rd year of their undergraduate degree programme at UIBE may apply for **conditional admission to the MITB Programme**. During their 4th year of study, the UIBE student joins the MITB programme in Singapore as a Fast-Track student and completes the undergraduate degree thesis plus **15 Course Units (CUs)** of MITB, while maintaining a **minimum cGPA score of 2.5**. The suggested time frame for completing MITB requirements is **1.5 years**, with a maximum candidature period of up to **3 years**. Conferment of SMU’s MITB degree is conditional on the successful conferment of UIBE’s Bachelor of Engineering degree.
